metadata.title: The Thurston spine and equivariant cell decompositions in genus 2
metadata.abstract: The Thurston spine of the genus 2 Teichmüller space of closed compact surfaces is obtained. In particular, we identify all mapping class group-orbits of filling sets of systoles in genus 2. Thereby, surprisingly rich cases already appear in this simplest case which is genus 2. This is contrasted with a cell decomposition of a bordification of Teichmüller space obtained computationally using Rivin's angle coordinates, on which the cells are labelled by Delaunay graphs closely related to our systolic graphs.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 亏格二 Teichmüller 空间的 Thurston spine
analysis.workSummary: 确定闭亏格二曲面 Teichmüller 空间的 Thurston spine，辨认填充 systole 集的全部映射类群轨道，并与基于 Rivin 角坐标计算的边界化胞腔分解比较。
analysis.breakthrough: 完整呈现亏格二情形中丰富的组合轨道结构。
analysis.limitations: 分类限定亏格二；计算得到的胞腔分解与 systole spine 是相关但不同的对象。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Kimi k2.5 辅助生成解方程、数值求导、线性和二次规划、凸函数梯度下降的代码；ChatGPT 5 整理既有可运行代码，并润色第 4.3 节英文。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 Kimi k2.5 辅助生成解方程、数值求导、线性和二次规划、凸函数梯度下降的代码；ChatGPT 5 整理既有可运行代码，并润色第 4.3 节英文。
